properties.description: Lead a cross-department programme that puts LLM evaluation on one shared platform, so release decisions rest on trustworthy scores: independent benchmark reproduction, catching scoring errors, and automatic checkpoint scoring for the training team.

Post-training methods that recover quality after compression — knowledge distillation, including SubDistill and top-K logit distillation, and quantization-aware healing — described in three 2026 preprints.

Designed and shipped an interpretable subspace-based distillation method that compresses 600M+ parameter foundation models from scratch, taking it from research prototype to a reproducible production pipeline.
Applied the distillation approach to gigapixel-scale histopathology models across 100M image patches, cutting inference latency and memory use with minimal accuracy impact.
Built and shipped a production retrieval-augmented generation pipeline for clinical reporting — CLIP, BioGPT, and PEFT adapters served at low latency with vLLM, TensorRT, and ONNX.
Directed development of an open-source brain-imaging software package — GitHub Actions CI/CD, Docker, and full test coverage — now widely adopted as a benchmark in the neuroimaging community.
